Open Calendar → “Create” → “Event”
2. Enter title, date, time, and details
3. Set a notification (e.g., 1 day before) | | **Apple Calendar** | 1. Open Calendar → “+” → “New Event”
2. Fill in details
3. Add alert (e.g., 1 day before) | | **Microsoft Outlook** | 1. Calendar → “New Appointment”
2. Input info
3. Set reminder | | **Notes App** | 1. Create new note
2. Paste the above text
3. Use the app’s reminder feature if available | If you’d like, let me know which app you’re using and I can walk you through the exact steps. Happy renewing!
